svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Crosswalk architecture
svg.desc: OpenFEMA, SEC EDGAR, NOAA GHCN-Daily and the company_dns SIC list are read only through Zetaris Lightning: REST and filestore tables, cached SchemaStore views in the container cw, and the crosswalk_usl Unified Semantic Layer with foreign-key data-quality rules. A gateway exposes 59 named SQL templates and contract-checked registrar plans. In the agent server a Markovian discovery loop runs six discovery tools; Nemotron 3 Nano 4B on local Ollama chooses the next step and proposes join keys from a menu of probed columns, deterministic tools measure every key as a match rate in Lightning SQL, H-MEM keeps verified keys for the next question, the World Model keeps key edges with their measurement time, and every number cites the SQL that produced it. The analyst reads the discovery timeline, the join map, the semantic layer with its DQ results and the cited answer in the UI.
svg.text: Crosswalk: measure how three agencies' data join, then answer from the joins
One machine: Zetaris Lightning in local Docker, the gateway and the agent server on 127.0.0.1, Nemotron in local Ollama. No cloud model calls.
degree days computed in Lightning SQL
6 foreign keys, each a measured join key
RUN DQ at onboarding: MGE Energy invalid
2 DQ rules run live on every question
Match rates are Lightning SQL over the
cached views; the agent never writes SQL.
The gateway's named templates do, and the
logged SQL text is the citation of every
at most 12 chunks, carried state at most 800 tokens
fixed order = a checklist; invalid reply: repair, then
the host takes the next step (a counted fallback)
every number cites its Lightning SQL, rows, object,
endpoint, licence, time, latency and cache state
Ask; Discovery timeline (live over SSE, or REPLAY);
Join map: both rates, the verdict in plain words,
orphans by name; USL and DQ: the governed model
and the invalid row; Answer: click any number for its SQL
Which investor-owned electric utilities served states with FEMA
major-disaster declarations in Q1 2025, what did the weather
at their stations do, and did their revenue hold up year on year?
The FEMA join selects the utilities; none is hand-picked.
